Australia Awards are transformational Scholarships for international students, funded by the Australian Government.
Be inspired by Australia Awards alumni.
Find out more

Australia Awards are transformational Scholarships for international students, funded by the Australian Government.

The Australia Awards offer the next generation of global leaders an opportunity to undertake study, research and professional development in Australia.

Use this website to find online Australia Awards resources – how to apply, prepare to depart, connect in Australia, and return home to join our global alumni.
